title: [VIC] Gardena Classic 10m Hose Reel Kit $35 (Was $74) @ Bunnings, Nunawading
body:
Deal: [VIC] Gardena Classic 10m Hose Reel Kit $35 (Was $74) @ Bunnings, Nunawading

[angelkulit025] Not available on their website now. Hard to check stock levels

[superforever] Wondering if it all store the same price?
[arlsman] I called local Baldivis in WA got them to peice match previous low of $25.
[angelkulit025] May I ask what did you compare it with for price match?
[arlsman] this deal was available earlier - https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/964491 , So i just called the bunnings store and asked if they'd price match the SA store as it was on clearance for different prices around Oz. The guy i spoke to agreed to match it for $25. When i picked it up they had at least 20 units and so i got a second one for $25 too. Some stores happily pricematch, others don't
[nocure] You can check individual store price in this Link
[angelkulit025] Bunnings Broadmeadows advertised @$55 too
[Fanzao] https://www.gardena.com/au/products/lawn-care/battery-lawnmo…
mower looks this one
[theUnderdog] This is how much it should be priced in the first place.
[Domingo] This thing is a lot better quality than other options at $35. I've had one for over 5 years now and it's almost still as good as new
[angelkulit025] Just asked the information desk for price match, they do price match with other Bunnings store. Got it for $35 here at Broadmeadows Bunnings.
[Craze] Good tip! Might pop in to my local to see if they're willing to price match also (showing $55.50)
[DJcap] Was told by bunnings cannonhills QlD tgey dont price match other stores
[Domingo] Gotta love Bunnings staff who decline price matches as if you're asking them to give up a family member.
[deadfishies] Bought this last week at Bunnings northmead in NSW on clearance for $25. Plenty of stock last week when I purchased.
[angelkulit025] To those who have bought already.. Does it come with the shorter hose connecting the reel to the main tap?
[Domingo] From memory no, you cut a piece of the main hose to make the link hose or buy a separate one.
[angelkulit025] Ohh.. I see.. Thanks! Saves me from going back to Bunnings and inspecting the other boxes on the shelf 😂🤣
[jeffr] Bunnings Underwood had a few the other week at $35 - best to call the store first to see if they have stock.
